## About
Arvada West Auto and Truck is a family-owned business delivering honest and professional automotive repair and auto maintenance to the people of Arvada, Golden, Wheat Ridge and Westminster.
We're a certified NAPA AutoCare auto and truck center. We use the latest automotive technology and handle major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles.
Your vehicle is a major investment, so we treat it as if it was our own. Customers rate us 4.4 from 86 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brake Repair: Our team is equipped to repair all brake systems. If you hear squeaking or grinding, bring it in before it gets worse.
- Oil Change: We change your oil and check for any potential problems with your vehicle while it's here.
- Air Conditioning: We'll fix your A/C so you stay comfortable on the road all year.
- Maintenance: Preventative maintenance to keep your vehicle in excellent shape.
- Diesel Light Truck Repair: Repair work for diesel light trucks, right here in Arvada.
- Major and minor repairs: We use the latest automotive technology and handle major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: Send us an appointment request online. It doesn't lock in the time you pick, but we'll be in touch within 24 hours to schedule a time that works for you.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my car?
A: Yes. When you request an appointment, you can choose to wait for your vehicle or leave it with us.

Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: Our team can service all makes and models of vehicles.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Arvada and serve drivers from Arvada, Golden, Wheat Ridge and Westminster.
